name: Open Library
tagline: Internet Archive book catalog with search, editions, and cover images.
description: Open Library is an Internet Archive project that exposes a free public API for searching books, resolving works and editions by ISBN/OLID, fetching metadata (authors, subjects, publish dates), and retrieving cover images. Developers use it for catalog lookup, book discovery, and enrichment without requiring commercial licensing for typical read-only access.

auth.details: Read-only catalog and cover endpoints require no authentication. Some write/account features may require login; typical public use is unauthenticated.

example.response_snippet: {"numFound":...,"docs":[{"key":"/works/OL...","title":"The Lord of the Rings","author_name":["J. R. R. Tolkien"],...}]}

use_cases: search books by title or author
look up a book edition by ISBN
get cover image URLs for a book
resolve Open Library IDs for catalog linking
